description: SEO audit of one web page, covering technical SEO and AI search readiness: how search engines, AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and AI agents read it. It checks indexing (status, robots, canonical), title and meta description, headings and copy, schema markup (JSON-LD), links, image alt text and AI readiness. Use it when the person asks for an SEO or website audit of a page, how a page does in search or AI answers, or what to fix first. result has url (where the page landed), status, scores (passed and judged checks per layer: seo, geo, axo), problems (each with check id, status fail or partial, severity, a one-line summary and evidence), passed and notApplicable (check ids). Results are cached for 15 minutes. These are deterministic checks of public pages fetched by Agent Ready Website Audit, with no AI model and no account. They do not cover rankings, keyword volumes, backlinks or how AI answers mention the brand. Returns JSON: summary (one sentence), reportUrl (a shareable report page for the person, kept 30 days; null for tools that keep none) and result (the details below). Errors come back as one plain sentence. Recorded: the checked domain and path (never the query string), the tool, which checks failed and the app name; never an IP address or page text.

brandName.description: The brand name as people search for it, such as "Acme Running". When given, the organization identity check compares the page schema with it. Defaults to none.

url.description: The page to check: an absolute http or https URL, such as https://example.com/pricing.

name: seo_audit_page
title: SEO audit of one page
